The javadoc for getEntry says it throws IllegalStateException if the ZIP file has been closed. In this snippet, the ZipFile is newly created and not closed before the call to getEntry. There is no other code that could close it. The method does not close the ZipFile afterwards (it only gets an InputStream and returns it, without closing the ZipFile). Therefore, at the time of the call, the ZipFile is open. So the condition for IllegalStateException (file closed) is avoided.
answer: IllegalStateException: not thrown because the ZipFile is open.
